front_matter.title: tug
front_matter.description: Tows a vessel between the open water and its berth.

markdown:
Tows a vessel between the open water and its berth. ## Depends on - [vessel](./vessel.mdx) · layer 2 · craft · 4 references ## Used by No block depends on this one. ## Entities ### Tug Identified by `tug_id` (`TugId`). | field | type | |---|---| | `vessel_id` | `VesselId` | | `started_at` | `timestamp` | Relations: - `vessel_id` references **Vessel** of [vessel](./vessel.mdx) (one, by `vessel_id`) ## Commands ### RetireTug **Retire a tug.** | field | type | |---|---| | `tug_id` | `TugId` | | `at` | `timestamp` | | outcome | when | result | |---|---|---| | `no-such-tug` (refused) | no such Tug | `TugNotFound`: No tug of this identity exists. | | `retired` | otherwise | moves the **Tug** `Active` → `Retired`; emits `TugRetired` | | `wrong-state` (refused) | the Tug is in a state that does not allow it | `TugStateConflict`: The tug is not in a state this command acts from. | ### StartTug **Start a tug.** | field | type | |---|---| | `tug_id` | `TugId` | | `vessel_id` | `VesselId` | | `at` | `timestamp` | | outcome | when | result | |---|---|---| | `started` | otherwise | creates a **Tug** in `Active`; emits `TugStarted` | ## Events | event | fields | emitted by | |---|---|---| | `TugRetired` | `tug_id` TugId, `at` timestamp | `RetireTug` | | `TugStarted` | `tug_id` TugId, `at` timestamp | `StartTug` | ## Views | view | rows | fields | |---|---|---| | `Tugs`
Tugs | each **Tug** | `tug_id` TugId, `vessel_id` VesselId, `started_at` timestamp, `state` State | ## KPIs 1 KPI from the [KPI catalogue](../../kpis.mdx). ### Efficiency | KPI | unit | better | gate | status | |---|---|---|---|---| | `tug_wait_minutes`
Minutes a vessel waits for a tug at the harbor mouth.
By tides: flood: lower, ebb: ignore | minutes | lower | – | sketched | ## Documents using it - [cove](../../plan/cove.mdx) (Harbor plans) · 1 part - [reef](../../plan/reef.mdx) (Harbor plans) · 1 part
